jobs.description: 🌎 What we do Root is Europe’s #1 primary data collection platform for F&B companies. We help our customers to measure and reduce farm-level emissions. ~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. jobs.description: <h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.</p> <p>We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.</p> <p>When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable.
